about: Other names shoppers type for recipes, used by the meal plan's Quick add (POST /mealplan/selection/parse) at its alias step. `recipes` maps a library slug to whole alternative names; `token_aliases` maps one recipe-title word to spellings of it and applies to every recipe the matcher knows (library, demo starters and the shopper's own). Written for this demo; an alias match is always shown to the shopper to confirm, never accepted on its own.
